long_biography.plain_text:
Automobile retailing was already a family enterprise when Charles W. Foulke III entered the business. His father, Charles W. Foulke Jr., established Foulke Management Corporation in 1967. The younger Foulke developed experience across sales, service, parts and collision-centre operations. He eventually became vice president, with responsibility for eight South Jersey dealerships representing five automotive manufacturers.

His leadership is also documented at individual franchises. A General Motors agreement designated him a partial owner and dealer operator of Mall Chevrolet. The role required full managerial authority. The Better Business Bureau currently lists him as owner of Mt. Ephraim Chrysler Dodge Ram. Outside the dealerships, Cooper University Health Care credits him with supporting youth athletic facilities and community organisations, including Catholic Charities.
